title: Feed A Crowd: Ratatouille Pasta Bake
subtitle: Cook Once, Serve More!
description: Serve up more with our Feed A Crowd recipes! Using the same amount of protein but with more hearty ingredients like filling carbs and veggies added, you can satisfy extra hungry tummies or keep something for tomorrow’s lunch. If you’re on a 2-person plan, these recipes make 4 portions; on a 4-person plan, they make 8 portions.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 200C, fan-forced (see Feed A Crowd). Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil for the pasta. Cut the capsicums, eggplant, zucchini and tomato into 1.5cm chunks. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Coarsely grate the cheese.

Soften veggies: Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a large saucepan over high heat. Cook the capsicum, eggplant, zucchini and tomato, stirring, for 2 mins or until starting to soften. Season with salt and pepper. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, covered, stirring occasionally, for 8 mins or until the eggplant is softened.
Cook pasta: Meanwhile, cook the pasta in the pan of boiling water for 6 mins or until almost al dente. Reserve 125ml (½ cup) cooking water, then drain the pasta.

Add pasta to sauce: Add the garlic, red pesto, 2 tbs tomato paste and ½ tsp sugar to the veggies, increase the heat to high and cook, stirring, for 30 secs or until combined. Stir in the reserved cooking water and bring to a simmer. Add the pasta (see Feed A Crowd) and toss to combine. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.
Bake and serve up: Transfer the pasta mixture to a 2L (8 cup) baking dish and scatter over the cheese. Bake for 8-10 mins until the cheese is golden. Divide the pasta bake among bowls and enjoy!
Feed A Crowd: Short on time? Skip the baking and simply serve the veggie pasta scattered with the cheese. ~ Toss the pasta and sauce together in a large bowl if your saucepan isn't big enough.
